name: swim_guardian_drops
description: Placed water, held out (physics.md 6.6): the player dropped 5 units above the surface of the placed water NVCleanWater2048x2048 (reference 0x0013F31A, scale 3, z 6528) in the interior CampGuardianCaves, whose CELL XCLW is 6712 (184 higher), over the pool at the south edge of the water's box (y -8704 at scale 3): three drops inside the box over floors 213-434 below the surface, three just outside it (56-146 units south of the edge) over floors 205-274 below. Each drop starts from a fresh coc to the cell, so the player is not swimming when placed. Points chosen 2026-10-08 from vertical rays of `fnvtool phys cell --cell CampGuardianCaves`.
